description: windowlicker submodule: gomft ($MFT records). ECS file.* copies from the record's own columns; file.path is ParentPath/FileName. The eight MFT timestamps stay as their own fields (typed by logs-dxdfir@windowlicker); the parent has already chosen Created0x10, the $STANDARD_INFORMATION creation time, as the evidence time.

script.if: ctx.ParentPath instanceof String && ctx.FileName instanceof String && ctx.file?.path == null
script.source: String d = ctx.ParentPath; if (!(ctx.file instanceof Map)) { ctx.file = [:]; } ctx.file.path = (d.endsWith('/') ? d : d + '/') + ctx.FileName;
